The '''X-Drone''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-[[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] variant of the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], which had superior capabilities and firepower to those of a standard Z-95. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the company [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] established an experimental facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]], known as the [[Cerise Fog Project]], which was used to create fields of fog to test the X-Drone in. However, the facility was eventually destroyed and details of the X-Drone project were kept secret. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], designers from the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]&mdash;the parent company of Bespin Motors&mdash;defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and during their withdrawal, a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] tech specialist salvaged an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that contained the schematics for the X-Drone.<ref name="CCW" />
